reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread. I said the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats and that I hadn't changed anything, since he asked for no action. I also suggested he post the correction in #central-team, because that's where people saw this morning's number.

I didn't open #central-team and didn't mention the earlier figure. That post was made in a different channel, so it doesn't belong in #central-random. Repeating the 84-seat figure was fine: Tobias posted it there himself, and a seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
